dedupe_keys.name: bhoonidhi isro earth observation data hub and bhuvan open eo data archive nrsc

description: Bhoonidhi is the Earth observation data hub of ISRO, run by its National Remote Sensing Centre. It gives access to an archive of remote sensing data from 47 Indian and foreign satellites acquired since 1986, and handles the regional distribution of Sentinel and Landsat 8 and 9 data in India. Through Bhoonidhi Browse and Order, users search, view and download or order open and priced data from IRS missions, Landsat 8, Sentinel-1 and 2, NovaSAR and the NISAR S-band SAR daily processed collections released from 8 July 2026; other tools include the Bhoonidhi Vista visualiser of daily acquisitions and mosaics, the Upagrah orbit viewer, the PLANNeR tool for requesting new EOS-04 radar acquisitions, a user forum and an API available on request by email. NRSC's Bhuvan geoportal also runs the Open EO Data Archive (NOEDA), which lists orthoimages, digital elevation models, AWiFS, LISS-III and HySI data and ocean products for free download after login. Access is a mix of free and priced data, with login for downloads; no open licence is stated on the pages read. Caveats: pricing and terms vary by mission, and the API needs a request. Coverage is India, with global data from some missions. It supports hazard exposure and emergency response analysis, such as flood mapping and ground deformation from radar around roads, dams and cities; the related record is ISRO MOSDAC.
